Hero.badge: Digital Development Center • National Bank of Kazakhstan
Hero.subtitle: The Digital Development Center of the National Bank of Kazakhstan is the technological core of the country's financial system. For over 20 years we have built and maintained the National Bank's key IT systems.

Services.subtitle: Key areas of activity of the Digital Development Center of the National Bank of Kazakhstan.

s1.title: Contact Center 1477
s1.desc: The National Bank's unified contact center. Technical and advisory support for administrative reporting and digital services. Free of charge across Kazakhstan.

s2.title: Procurement Portal Operator
s2.desc: Operator of the procurement portal — a single access point for e-procurement by the National Bank and its organizations. In operation since 2020.

s3.title: Technological Data Operator
s3.desc: Professional processing and management of data: database development and support, storage security, and adoption of modern technologies. Operator status since 2021.

s4.title: Unified IT Services Center
s4.desc: Engineering competence center: preparation, integration, installation and support of the National Bank's equipment and systems — from server stations to workstations.

s5.title: Information Systems Development
s5.desc: Full software product lifecycle. Since inception, 50 information systems have been built, 24 of which are in operation today (Agile, Waterfall).

s6.title: Information Security
s6.desc: Maintenance and management of information security systems since 2022: event monitoring and response, security policy updates, and cyber-awareness training for staff.

About.description: The Digital Development Center of the National Bank of Kazakhstan (DDC) is the specialized technological wing of the National Bank. By providing the Bank and its subsidiaries with advanced IT solutions, we accelerate innovation, ensure stability, and comply with the international ISO 9001 standard.

v1.title: Innovation
v1.text: Adopting advanced IT solutions that accelerate the National Bank's digital transformation.

v2.title: Quality
v2.text: Compliance with the international ISO 9001 standard and high standards of service delivery.

v3.title: Reliability
v3.text: Uninterrupted operation of the country's critical financial-infrastructure systems.

CTA.subtitle: The National Bank's unified contact center and DDC specialists are ready to help with state digital services, reporting, and inquiries.

Security.description: Since 2022, DDC has maintained and managed the National Bank's information-security systems. We continuously monitor and respond to events, update security policies, and train staff in cyber-awareness, ensuring compliance with national and international standards.

f1.title: Monitoring & response
f1.desc: Continuous monitoring, analysis and response to events in information systems to prevent threats.

f2.title: Policies & cyber-awareness
f2.desc: Managing protective mechanisms, updating security policies, and training staff in cybersecurity fundamentals.

f3.title: Compliance & anti-corruption
f3.desc: Anti-corruption standards, compliance-risk and conflict-of-interest management. Hotline: +7 (727) 258 49 58.

Digital.subtitle: Since 2021, DDC has been building the National Bank's digital core — from information-systems development to data management — improving the efficiency and reliability of state processes.

t1.title: The National Bank's digital core
t1.description: Building the National Bank's 'digital core': digitalizing internal processes and improving the efficiency of staff.

t2.title: Information systems development
t2.description: Full software product lifecycle. Since inception, 50 information systems have been built, 24 of which are in operation today.

t3.title: Technological data operator
t3.description: Since 2021, DDC is the National Bank's technological data operator: professional processing and management of information in the digital environment.

Timeline.subtitle: From the establishment of a republican state enterprise to the leading technological core of the National Bank of Kazakhstan.

y1996.title: Enterprise Creation
y1996.desc: Establishment of the republican state enterprise to serve the needs of the National Bank of the Republic of Kazakhstan.

y2003.title: Quality Management
y2003.desc: Implementation of the quality management system (QMS) in accordance with international standards.

y2015.title: JSC BSB NBK
y2015.desc: Reorganization into the Joint-Stock Company 'Banking Service Bureau of the National Bank of Kazakhstan'.

y2017.title: Center of Competence
y2017.desc: Transformation from a single-project team into a scale IT competence center of the fintech ecosystem.

y2020.title: Services Expansion
y2020.desc: Launch of the Procurement Portal, maintenance of the Risk Management System, launch of the Contact Center 1477, administration of information security tools, and digital transformation.

y2025.title: Digital Development Center
y2025.desc: Renaming to JSC 'Digital Development Center of the National Bank of Kazakhstan' and scaling target responsibilities.

Leadership.subtitle: Professionals in the IT industry ensuring the stability of digital solutions of Kazakhstan's financial system.

l1.name: Malik A. Amardinov
l1.desc: Our goal is to create a reliable, scalable, and secure digital ecosystem for the financial sector of Kazakhstan that meets the best global standards.

l2.name: Erlan D. Durmagambetov
l2.role: First Deputy Chairman of the Board
l2.desc: Digital transformation of the National Bank requires synergy of advanced technologies, a strong engineering team, and strict quality standards.

l3.name: Argyn S. Kentbekov
l3.desc: We ensure the uninterrupted operation of key IT systems and the development of the state procurement portal, increasing process transparency.

l4.name: Bakhytzhan G. Imajanov
